top_signals.title: Fed's Waller Sees Some Flexibility on Rate-Hike Timing
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said further interest-rate hikes will likely be needed to slow inflation. Speaking at an event organized by Turkey's central bank in Istanbul, Waller said he anticipates "additional hikes to support a timelier return to inflation" to the 2% goal. (Source: TCMB Istanbul Economic Forum)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Peppa Pig gets Lionesses call-up as Football Association scores licensing deal with Hasbro
top_signals.summary: Peppa Pig maker Hasbro has struck a licensing deal with the Football Association that will see a new character, Libby Lioness, join the hit children’s animated TV show.
